notes.title: The Songs of HMong is OUT NOW! Come and sing the song to save the world!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  

The music puzzle game "Songs of HMong" is officially released today with a launch discount of 15% off. 

The game is inspired by the music culture of the HMong, and the story is adapted from the ancient Miao literary work "Song of the Maple." Players will embark on an adventure filled with music and puzzles from the perspective of a HMong girl.  

The game features an unique picture book style, combined with exquisite art of paper folding, creating a dreamlike yet realistic world of the HMong. Players will follow the clues guided by ancient melodies, gradually delving into the scenes to uncover those unknown clue fragments and piece them together into more wonderful musical scores. Each melody in the game represents a clue to a puzzle, and players can also choose to play more complex musical rhythms and attempt to achieve higher scores, helping the young Miao find a way to save the world.

Welcome to join our Discord(Puzzle-Game Group): 2pgames.net/discord
